PCA: sklearn PCA(2) on observed log1p CP10K of 2021 expanded features; centered, unscaled; no VAE
reference: mean observed IKZF2 log1p in Treg cells (median is 0)
KO_rule: per cell: a=x_IKZF2/reference; x_target=max(0,x_target-a*power); x_IKZF2=0; others unchanged
direction: bin mean of per-cell (x_KO-x) @ PCA.components.T, unit-normalized for direction
power: L2 norm of bin-mean GRN target expression change (IKZF2 itself excluded)
arrow: direction * power * one common linear scale
caveats: GRN powers were estimated from the expanded VAE decoder in Treg cells and are applied to observed expression with assumed linear IKZF2-amplitude scaling. Cells without detected IKZF2 receive no response (dropout possible). Not causal, experimental KO, or time velocity.
